posts.text: 🤖 AI Platform Banks Are Racing Into AI Faster Than Security Can Follow PYMNTS · 🟧 Claude · 2h ago • Anthropic introduced Model Context Protocol (MCP) in late 2024 as an open standard for AI agents to connect to business systems. • Banks are adopting AI faster than security measures can keep pace with deployment. • MCP uses a common interface instead of custom connections, similar to how applications call APIs. Read more →

🤖 AI Platform OpenAI’s Chief Futurist Is Leaving the Company Wired – AI · 🟢 ChatGPT · 4h ago • Joshua Achiam, OpenAI's Chief Futurist, is departing after nearly nine years at the company. • Achiam led AI safety research and testified in the Musk v. Altman lawsuit. • His departure represents a loss of senior research leadership at OpenAI. Read more →

🤖 AI Platform Copilot goes cheap as Microsoft phases out OpenAI and Anthropic models to cut costs The Decoder · 🟧 Claude · 🟢 ChatGPT · 7h ago • Microsoft is replacing OpenAI and Anthropic models with its own MAI models in Copilot products. • Tens of thousands of weekly queries already run through Microsoft's internal models in Excel and Outlook. • AI chief Mustafa Suleyman aims to eliminate costs of external third-party models. 📰 Also covered by: TechCrunch AI Read more →

🤖 AI Platform Why the rise of open source AI isn’t hurting Anthropic … yet TechCrunch AI · 🟧 Claude · 6h ago • Open source AI success is not directly competing with frontier labs like Anthropic. • Open source and proprietary models appear to serve different phases of the same AI adoption cycle. • Anthropic remains unharmed by open source AI's rapid growth. 🤖 AI Platform Anthropic is launching Claude Cowork on mobile and web The Verge – AI · 🟧 Claude · 8h ago • Anthropic is launching Claude Cowork on mobile and web starting Tuesday. • Max subscribers get immediate access; other Claude users will gain access in the coming weeks. • Claude Cowork was previously available only on desktop. 📰 Also covered by: The Decoder, TechCrunch AI Read more →
